title: Cloudflare outage, 18 November 2025
label: Replay built from the public postmortem; illustrative, not an accuracy measurement.
what_happened: A change to database access controls in a ClickHouse cluster made a query that builds the Bot Management 'feature file' return duplicate rows, so the file roughly doubled in size (paraphrased from the postmortem).
The core proxy's Bot Management module had a limit on the file size that the doubled file exceeded; the proxy failed and customers saw HTTP 5xx errors.

Workers KV (its front-end gateway runs on the proxy), Access, Turnstile and dashboard login failed as a consequence; the status page also went down at the same time, which the postmortem says was a coincidence.
assumptions: Dependencies are the ones the postmortem describes; the 'official map' is our construction of what a service catalog would list.

The invisible dependency is the generated feature file: the proxy's Bot Management module loads a file that a separate job builds from a ClickHouse query and distributes network-wide. A service catalog lists the job's query on ClickHouse, not the file the proxy loads.
Alerts are in the order the postmortem describes the failures; their spacing is normalised (the real gaps were minutes).
